free_tier.stated: no free credit is stated for a registration outside mainland China. The API needs a recharge of at least USD 1 first, and a USD 5 voucher is granted once cumulative recharge reaches USD 5. The mainland RMB 15 new-user voucher is a separate offer on a separate platform; accounts and keys of the two platforms are independent
free_tier.notes: the USD 5 voucher is a purchase-matched bonus, not a free grant; whether the console grants any other credit at sign-up is unverified: behind a sign-up. One page names 'vouchers granted from new-user verification' that cannot be used for Kimi K3 without saying who receives them or how much

tooling: OpenAI-compatible REST at https://api.moonshot.ai/v1, with Chat Completions, Responses and an Anthropic-compatible Messages interface; a console Playground; a balance API
chaining: top up USD 1 to unlock the API, then USD 5 cumulative for a USD 5 voucher; usage deducts half from cash and half from vouchers; the voucher does not count towards the rate-limit tier

limits.value: a recharge of at least USD 1 is required before the API can be used; kimi-k3.1-pro is unlocked by a successful top-up (minimum USD 1)
Tier0 (USD 1 cumulative recharge): concurrency 1, 3 RPM, 500,000 TPM, 1,500,000 TPD; Tier1 (USD 10): concurrency 15, 100 RPM, 2,000,000 TPM, unlimited TPD
USD 5 voucher once cumulative recharge reaches USD 5; vouchers do not count towards the cumulative recharge total

binding_note: nothing is callable before a paid recharge of at least USD 1; the USD 5 voucher only matches paid recharge

identity_cost.detail: sign-up uses an emailed verification code or a Google account; using the API needs a prior top-up of at least USD 1. The help page lists WeChat Pay and Alipay QR payments for individual top-ups and the terms name a credit or debit card as a payment method; which methods the international top-up page accepts is unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: not assessed: no request was sent to the endpoint. A Tier0 account runs one request at a time
confidence_note: the USD 1 minimum, the USD 5 voucher, the tier table, the sign-in methods and the regional separation are quoted from the vendor's international docs; the console sign-up and top-up pages are behind a login and were not read, so any further sign-up grant and the accepted payment methods are unverified

evidence.quote: To prevent abuse, a minimum recharge of \$1 is required to start using the API; when your cumulative recharge reaches \$5, you receive a \$5 voucher.
evidence.proved: a recharge of at least USD 1 is required before the API can be used, and a USD 5 voucher follows once cumulative recharge reaches USD 5

evidence.quote: Vouchers do not count towards the cumulative recharge total.
evidence.proved: the voucher does not raise the rate-limit tier
the USD 1 tier allows concurrency 1, 3 RPM, 500,000 TPM and 1,500,000 TPD
the USD 10 tier allows concurrency 15, 100 RPM, 2,000,000 TPM and no daily token cap

evidence.quote: Email sign-in: Receive a verification code at your email address.
evidence.proved: sign-in on the international platform works with an emailed verification code

evidence.quote: Sign in with Google: Authorize Kimi Platform through Google's OAuth sign-in flow.
evidence.proved: a Google account is the other sign-in method

evidence.quote: Kimi K3.1 Pro is unlocked after a successful top-up (minimum \$1).
evidence.proved: the flagship model needs a successful top-up of at least USD 1

evidence.quote: Kimi Open Platform provides separate regional platforms. For users outside mainland China, use platform.kimi.ai.
evidence.proved: platform.kimi.ai is the platform for registrations outside mainland China

evidence.quote: Accounts and keys from different regional platforms are independent and cannot be mixed.
evidence.proved: an international account is separate from a mainland account, so a mainland voucher does not carry over

evidence.quote: You can run a minimal test in the [Playground](https://platform.kimi.ai/playground) to confirm whether a model and prompt fit your scenario
evidence.proved: the vendor points to a console Playground for testing before a top-up

evidence.quote: Online top-ups support WeChat Pay and Alipay QR code payments.
evidence.proved: the help page lists WeChat Pay and Alipay QR payments for individual top-ups

evidence.quote: By providing a payment method (such as a credit or debit card), Customer authorizes Moonshot AI and its payment processors to charge such payment method on a recurring and/or usage-based basis
evidence.proved: the platform terms name a credit or debit card as a payment method

evidence.quote: To use the Services as an individual, you must be at least 18 years old or the minimum age required by your country to consent to such use.
evidence.proved: an individual account needs the age of 18 or the local minimum age of consent

evidence.quote: Account usage is now deducted at a uniform ratio of 50% cash and 50% vouchers.
evidence.proved: usage is deducted half from cash balance and half from vouchers
kimi-k3.1-pro is priced at USD 2.00 per MTok input and USD 10.00 per MTok output

evidence.quote: Kimi K3 requires available balance in your account; vouchers granted from new-user verification cannot be used for Kimi K3.
evidence.proved: a new-user verification voucher, if granted, does not cover Kimi K3
